visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a small sailboat with a single sail navigating on a flat, light-colored surface, possibly ice or water. In the foreground, a pack of dark, wolf-like animals is running across the surface toward the right. In the sky above, several large birds, resembling eagles or vultures, are flying in the direction of the boat.
